breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。

master.name_en: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region gene somatic hypermutation
master.definition_en: A recently recognized variant of chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) expressing somatic hypermutations of the Immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) genes. The recognition of this variant alters the belief that CLL/SLL is always derived from a naive, pregerminal center B-cell. The presence of somatic hypermutations of IGH genes occurs in approximately 50% of CLL/SLL cases and implies a postgerminal center, memory origin. Patients with this variant of CLL/SLL have a favorable prognosis, with a reported median survival of more than 24 years.
synonyms_en: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region gene somatic hypermutation

curated.category: 免疫介导炎症性皮肤病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 免疫介导的慢性复发性皮肤炎症（绝对不传染！），寻常型本身不直接致死；但若因滥用激素或偏方诱发泛发性脓疱型或红皮病型银屑病，可因高热、低蛋白血症与败血症危及生命，且中重度患者心血管事件与代谢综合征风险显著升高。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽尚无法彻底断根防复发，但已进入“皮损全清（PASI 90/100）”的生物制剂时代：司库奇尤单抗、依奇珠单抗、古塞奇尤单抗及口服TYK2抑制剂氘可来昔替尼均已纳入国家常规药品目录，可安全高效地让绝大部分中重度患者皮肤恢复如常。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD 2021未将银屑病单列为直接死因，主要负担为皮损毁容、瘙痒与共病（关节炎/心血管病）

non_drug_therapies_zh: 严正避坑：切忌口服或静脉注射系统性糖皮质激素（如地塞米松/泼尼松“特效偏方”），停药后极易引发灾难性反跳甚至致命性红皮病/脓疱型银屑病！

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 双靶点IL-17A/F单抗比美吉珠单抗（Bimekizumab）及国内自研IL-17/IL-23生物制剂（如夫那奇珠单抗、古塞奇尤单抗及司库奇尤单抗国产生物类似药BAT2306）接连在华获批，大幅拉低治疗门槛；2) 口服多肽IL-23受体拮抗剂JNJ-2113（Icotrokinra）在3期ICONIC试验中达到极高皮损清除率，有望开启“口服生物制剂级”新时代。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 所有现有靶向药停药后仍存在较高复发率，尚未实现持久免疫耐受或“治愈”；2) 民间“祖传根治偏方”暗含重金属（汞/砷）或隐匿激素导致肝肾衰竭与反跳的悲剧仍屡见不鲜；3) 特殊部位（头皮、甲、掌跖）及泛发性脓疱型（已获批佩索利单抗）基层规范诊疗仍待普及。

master.definition_en: Osteoarthritis of the foot generally affects the joint at the base of your big toe. It can cause your toe to: - become stiff over time, which can make it difficult and painful to walk – this is called hallux rigidus - become bent, which can lead to painful bunions (bony lumps at the base of your big toe) – this is called hallux valgus. Osteoarthritis of the mid-foot is also quite common, especially in older people, and may cause an obvious bony swelling (osteophyte) on the top of your mid-foot. Ankle osteoarthritis is least common and may cause your heel to move to an unusual angle.

master.name_en: non-spherocytic hemolytic anemia due to hexokinase deficiency
master.definition_en: Nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia due to hexokinase deficiency (NSHA due to HK1 deficiency) is a very rare conditionmainly characterized by severe, chronic hemolysis, beginning in infancy. Approximately 20 cases of this condition have been described to date. Signs and symptoms of hexokinase deficiency are very similar to those of pyruvate kinase deficiency but anemia is generally more severe. Some affected individuals reportedly have had various abnormalities in addition to NSHA including multiple malformations, panmyelopathy, and latent diabetes.Itcan be caused by mutations in the HK1 gene and is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. Treatment may include red cell transfusions for those with severe anemia.

master.name_en: linear skin defects with multiple congenital anomalies
master.definition_en: A genetic condition that affects the eyes and skin. It is mainly found in females and is characterized by small or poorly developed eyes (microphthalmia) and characteristic linear skin markings on the head and neck. The signs and symptoms of this condition may include abnormalities of the brain, heart, and genitourinary system. Other symptoms may include short stature, developmental delay, and finger and toenails that do not grow normally (nail dystrophy). MLS syndrome is typically caused by either a deletion of certain genetic material on the p (short) arm of the X chromosome or by a mutation in the HCCS gene. In some cases, it may be caused by mutations in the COX7B and NDUFB11 genes, (also located on the X chromosome). According to the mutated gene, the disease may be classified in three subtypes. This condition is inherited in an X-linked manner and is thought to result in serious early developmental concerns in males, leading to almost no males with this condition surviving to delivery.Although there is no specific treatment or cure for MLS syndrome, there may be ways to manage the symptoms. A team of doctors is often needed to figure out the treatment options based on each person's symptoms.

master.definition_en: Chronic diarrhea with villous atrophy is a rare, genetic gastroenterological disease characterized by the early onset of chronic diarrhea, vomiting, anorexia, lactic acidosis, renal insufficiency and hepatic involvement (mild elevation of liver enzymes, steatosis, hepatomegaly). Partial villous atrophy (with eosinophilic infiltration) is observed on intestinal biopsy. Although diarrhea may resolve, the development of neurologic symptoms (cerebellar ataxia, sensorineural deafness, seizures), retinitis pigmentosa and muscle weakness may complicate disease course and lead to death. There have been no further descriptions in the literature since 1994.

curated.name_zh: 心源性猝死与恶性心律失常
curated.name_en: Sudden cardiac death and malignant ventricular arrhythmias
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 典型‘黄金4分钟’超急性杀手：由急性冠脉缺血（约占70%）、肥厚型/扩张型心肌病、遗传性离子通道病（长QT、Brugada、CPVT）或暴发性心肌炎诱发室颤（VF）/无脉性室速（VT），心脏在数秒内丧失有效泵血；大脑缺血缺氧4–6分钟即发生不可逆损伤，每延迟CPR/除颤1分钟存活率下降7%–10%，院外心脏骤停未及时除颤10分钟后存活率极低。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 现场旁观者立即高质量CPR与AED早期电除颤是挽救生命的唯一决定性窗口；幸存者及高危原发病患者植入ICD（体内除颤器）联合抗心律失常药、导管消融可显著降低复发猝死风险，但院外抢救成功率全球仍偏低。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 约400万–500万例/年（ESC与《Lancet》心源性猝死委员会对全球SCD年死亡人数的权威估算区间，取下界400万作保守整数标引）
annual_deaths_global.source: The Lancet Commission on Sudden Cardiac Death / ESC (TCTMD 2023)

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国年心源性猝死约54.4万例（年发生率约41.8/10万人，国家心血管病中心阜外医院全国多中心监测研究）
annual_deaths_china.source: Chinese SCD Epidemiology Study / PACE PubMed PMID:19719492

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球年发病率约 40–100 / 10万人（与冠心病及遗传性心律失常分布相关；特发性室颤ORPHA:228140为罕见亚型）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国总体SCD发生率约 41.8 / 10万人·年（每年约54.4万例）；冠心病约占70%，但中青年猝死中遗传性心肌病与离子通道病占重要比例；我国历史ICD植入率极低（曾仅约1.5例/百万人），近年正随国产化提速

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 立即遵循ACLS生存链：1）确认无反应无呼吸后即刻呼叫120并启动胸外按压（100–120次/分、深5–6cm）与获取AED；2）室颤/无脉性室速即刻双相波电除颤（200J）并每2分钟评估节律；3）建立静脉通路每3–5分钟推注肾上腺素1mg，对电除颤顽固性室颤/室速予胺碘酮300mg静推（必要时追加150mg）或利多卡因；4）恢复自主循环（ROSC）后行急诊冠脉造影排查急性心梗及目标体温管理（TTM）神经保护。

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: A rare, isolated nail anomaly characterized by claw-shaped, thick, hyperplastic, hard and hyperpigmented nails, subungual hyperkeratosis, onycholysis and slow nail growth. Variable degree of disease severity has been reported.
